**setup:** `pixel setup` and `--remove` no longer clean up what earlier releases wrote (instruction blocks, rule files, the `claude()` wrapper, retired hook entries, Pi, OpenCode, Cursor, Copilot CLI and Warp artifacts), `--shell` and `--wrappers-only` are gone, and `--repo` writes only `.pixel/config.yaml`. The pre-rename command aliases, `migrate`, `config policy`, `config.json` and the retired `run-hook` verbs are removed.
